nightly.yml:59-64 says 'eval/harness.py does not exist yet — it is a later task' — but eval/harness.py clearly exists and is fully built. The nightly job currently only runs pytest -m ollama and never actually invokes eval/harness.py... the one number that matters is never measured in CI at all
docs/design.md:136 and the sweep default say 'Default k = 60' but RecallConfig.rrf_k is actually 10 (config.py:125). Nothing in code or docs explains this divergence

chunk_code's exception handling is broad (except Exception) around tree-sitter parsing (code.py:93-100), silently falling back to line-window chunking on any parser failure... IndexReport has no field for 'N files fell back to line-window chunking'
_store() and build_embedder(config) are reconstructed (new DB connection, new HTTP client) on every single tool call rather than reused (mcp_server.py:18-19, 41-43)

No confidence intervals, bootstrap, or significance testing is computed anywhere in metrics.py/harness.py — verdicts are point-estimate comparisons... a 'LOSES to a half' on 10 hybrid-kind queries could flip on a single query
limit has no validation at either config or MCP tool level; limit=0 silently returns nothing without any note; a negative limit is passed straight into SQL LIMIT
